response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink COLLATE BINARY = tr.transreg COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref COLLATE BINARY = t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count * 1.0 / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share FROM per_type), compared AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM compared WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL AND share > average_share;
